tagline: Right-angle turns down the middle of King and Queen County.
intro: From US 360 at St. Stephens Church, The Trail heads southeast down the length of King and Queen County, a winding road of right-angle turns that does duty as the county's main highway. It takes the hamlets one at a time, Bruington and Stevensville, then the county seat, then Little Plymouth, Shanghai and Elsom, before it meets Route 33 at Shacklefords.
Shacklefords is named for a family whose first Virginia ancestor, Roger Shackelford, turns up in a Gloucester County land grant of 1658. The spelling has never quite settled.

moments.title: Stevensville
moments.text: Near Stevensville, at the junction known as Dahlgrens Corner, Union colonel Ulric Dahlgren was killed in 1864 during an attempt on Jefferson Davis and his cabinet.

moments.title: King and Queen Court House
moments.text: The county seat counted 82 people in 2020 and keeps a courthouse of about 1750 that Union troops burned in 1864. It was repaired and is still in service.

moments.title: Upper Church, Stratton Major Parish
moments.text: Near Shanghai stands a brick church of the 1720s, gutted by fire in the 1840s and restored, used by Baptists and later Methodists since the early 1800s.
